'''''30th Anniversary Bash''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] performing at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The text, written in the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet known as [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], spelled out "uhl eharl." The painting was given to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who attended [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Nym's Anniversary Bash|Anniversary Bash]] at [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nym's Base|base]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

==Description==
The [[Painting/Legends|painting]] ''30th Anniversary Bash'' was rectangular and came with a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] frame.<ref name="SWG" /> The foreground depicted the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] and members of his [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|band]]&mdash;specifically the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] singer [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] and the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] [[chidinkalu]] flute player [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]]&mdash;performing at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BAND">{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Several multi-colored stage lights were shown illuminating the band's performance.<ref name="SWG" /> Within the background were [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious B. Crumb]], Jabba's [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] court jester,<ref name="JEST">{{StoryCite|story=That's Entertainment: The Tale of Salacious Crumb|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> in addition to one of Jabba's guards. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet, across the upper right corner spelled out "uhl eharl."<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
''30th Anniversary Bash'' became available sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] received it from [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], through his [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] when the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] attended Nym's [[Nym's Anniversary Bash|Anniversary Bash]] at [[Nym's Base]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Max_Rebo_Band.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The similar concept art by Ralph McQuarrie]]
''30th Anniversary Bash'' was a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players could use it as decoration for their house. It was added to the game as part of the ''Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild'' game update<ref name="SWG" /> on [[May 22]], [[2007]]<ref name="SWG date">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> and was given out to players who attended Nym's Anniversary Bash. The anniversary bash and the painting were meant to celebrate the thirtieth anniversary of the release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in theaters in [[1977]].<ref name="SWG" />

The image used for the painting is largely similar to a piece of concept art for the Max Rebo band done by conceptual designer [[Ralph McQuarrie]] during the development of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The Aurebesh lettering, spelling out "uhl eharl," resembles the name of [[Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)|''Uhl Eharl Khoehng'']], a story that appeared in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]].<ref name="Uhl Eharl">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref> Another painting from the game, ''[[Party Poster]]'', makes a similar reference.<ref name="SWG" />
